brief: Oil prices drop as US pauses Iran attacks; deadly shooting at Seattle food festival; Germany tightens terrorism laws after Berlin pride attack. New AI decision-support system for autism diagnosis and visual analytics tools for molecular graph neural networks highlight today's research.
news_summary: Oil prices slide after US pauses attacks on Iran to allow talks; three dead in Seattle shooting; Germany's Merz calls for tighter monitoring after Berlin pride attack suspect linked to ISIS. Meanwhile, Labour leads Reform UK for first time since Burnham became PM.
papers_summary: A study outlines clinician needs for AI-based decision support in autism assessment, while LatentFlow offers visual analytics for molecular graph neural networks. Other papers propose node-based interfaces for LLM-driven visualization and a taxonomy for edge bundling tasks.

zh.brief: 今日焦點：胡志偉赴英遭扣留面臨遣返；中國女童基因編輯治療死亡惹議；美伊暫停攻擊油價大跌；德國柏林驕傲遊行襲擊事件。
zh.news_summary: 前香港民主黨主席胡志偉赴英後被邊境部隊扣留，否認申請政治庇護，面臨遣返。中國女童接受基因編輯治療後死亡，引發官方調查。美伊暫停攻擊，油價大跌。

todays_image.caption: The giant kelp of "Macrocystis sp." can be harvested for biofuel, offering a renewable alternative as falling oil prices signal a shift away from conflict-driven energy markets.
